description: Docs gap: the zone-lockdown UPDATE body omits `description`, `paused` and `priority`, although CREATE accepts them and GET returns them — PUT without them silently resets the fields. Mirror the create-body members.

traits.smithy.api#documentation: An informative summary of the rule. This value is sanitized and any tags will be removed.
When true, indicates that the rule is currently paused.

The priority of the rule to control the processing order. A lower number indicates higher priority. If not provided, any rules with a configured priority will be processed before rules without a priority.
